name: Office and IT equipment requests
definition: Ordering, installing and managing computers, phones, turrets and cell phone plans for staff, and confirming receipt so purchases can be paid.

row.name: Office and IT equipment requests
row.tier_words: in the total: 10 or more times over 3 or more months by 2 or more staff

estimate.basis_words: worked out from the steps the emails show

row.stall_label: Requests wait on vendors and installers: the manager chases a carrier on a phone for a…
row.stall_summary: Requests wait on vendors and installers: the manager chases a carrier on a phone for a new staff member and acknowledges that moving turrets and reconfiguring desks takes time.
row.fix: A standard equipment request form routed to IT deployment, with automatic completion notices that trigger a receipt confirmation to the requester and close the requisition, plus a periodic usage report per phone plan member.
row.status_line: Not drafted: $27 a month is under the $85 drafting line
flags: one round shared with another process

synthesis.description: A desk manager requests turrets, handsets, headsets, PCs and cell phones for the real-time trading group, orders are assigned to IT deployment staff who install the equipment, and the manager adjusts group calling plans and services with the carrier. Purchasing staff ask the requester to confirm receipt so the purchase can be paid, and the requisition work tends to pile up with one person.
steps: The manager or staff member requests equipment or a phone plan change.
The order is logged and assigned to an IT deployment technician.
The technician prepares and installs the equipment and reports completion.
The manager follows up with vendors or carriers on outstanding items and plan settings.
Purchasing asks the requester to confirm the items were received.
The requisition is completed so the vendor can be paid.
synthesis.approach: A standard equipment request form routed to IT deployment, with automatic completion notices that trigger a receipt confirmation to the requester and close the requisition, plus a periodic usage report per phone plan member.
synthesis.rationale: The stalls are about handoffs: who owns requisitions, when receipt is confirmed, who chases vendors. A written procedure naming each owner and the receipt step addresses the ownership gap first.
